analyst.summary: This is the Piramal group's financial-services (retail and wholesale lending) business, still working through a multi-year cleanup of a legacy wholesale real-estate loan book inherited from an earlier acquisition. Reported revenue growth looks strong on paper, but a large part of that appears to reflect lumpy accounting/fair-value swings from the legacy book rather than steady growth in the core retail-lending franchise, and current profitability (return on equity) is close to zero. We are keeping this at Hold per house rules, but flagging it for a closer look given how much of the reported growth may not be representative of the underlying business.
